Finding: No customer or staff reschedule screen exists on the web widget, the staff desk or the mobile app. The API (reschedule.ts) is tested. Guppi Booking does not reschedule (the brief keeps customer rescheduling P1).
Why it is not P0 / what protects today: NOT SHIPPED in this release. customerRescheduleEnabled now ships OFF in a fresh database and is OFF in the live checklist; the route answers FEATURE_OFF while it is off (REL-LANG-042).
Proposed work: Build the screens (customer and staff) on each client, then run PAR-014 on devices. Keep the switch OFF until then.

Finding: RESOLVED for web and mobile code (V2): Guppi Booking panel built on the website (web/public/app.js) and the mobile app (GuppiBookScreen.tsx) on one server endpoint, /api/guppi/understand. Remaining: iOS, Android and real iPad runs are NOT_RUN; the mobile screen could not be type-checked or run here (no node_modules).
Why it is not P0 / what protects today: Switch guppiAssistEnabled ships OFF; with it off the endpoint answers FEATURE_OFF and the apps show no Guppi button. Standard booking works with Guppi off (tested).
Proposed work: Run PAR-004 on a real iPad, iPhone and Android phone; type-check the mobile screen in CI; then switch on for a staff pilot.

Finding: A refund requested on a live (not cancelled) booking does not lower the booking's paid figure. Reconcile reports it as an information finding REFUND_AFTER_PAYMENT_APPLIED.
Why it is not P0 / what protects today: Not a loss of money: the refund record exists and the ledger is derived from the records; it is a presentation difference on the booking.
Proposed work: Decide the rule (needs Sunny) and show the refund against the booking balance with a reversing record.

Finding: The retention (deposit) dispute workflow has no path for a customer no-show.
Why it is not P0 / what protects today: A no-show cannot be recorded as a retained deposit by this workflow, so nothing is retained wrongly.
Proposed work: Add the no-show reason and credit rules once UD-01 is confirmed.

Finding: RESOLVED (V2): language understanding now sits in front of the same booking commands: built-in reader for English, Gujarati, Hindi, romanized Gujarati and Hindi and mixed input; an optional model fills only date/time/length gaps (REL-LANG-043).
Why it is not P0 / what protects today: The reader only produces a canonical request; every figure, availability and permission still comes from Daji.
Proposed work: If wanted, add language understanding in front of the same commands, with the same strict fields.

Finding: Large chunked library uploads are scanned per chunk with ClamAV INSTREAM, which is limited by the daemon's StreamMaxLength; a very large file is scanned in pieces.
Why it is not P0 / what protects today: An infected piece is still caught and the upload deleted; a pattern that spans pieces could be missed.
Proposed work: Scan the assembled file by path (clamd SCAN) or raise the limit, then re-run REL-FILE-001 against real ClamAV.

Finding: Replaced files are kept as versions (file_versions) with no retention period, so storage grows.
Why it is not P0 / what protects today: Nothing is lost; disk is monitored.
Proposed work: Agree a retention period and add a clean-up that records what it removed.

Finding: The construction suite has no route to replace a document, so versioning of replaced documents cannot be exercised there.
Why it is not P0 / what protects today: Uploads are scanned; no replacement exists to protect.
Proposed work: Add replace-with-version if the business needs it.

Finding: Daji 2.0 (separate foundation with database-level row security and exclusion constraints) is not adopted. The current system is kept.
Why it is not P0 / what protects today: Frozen architecture; the current allocation guard (slot primary key) is proven.
Proposed work: Plan a later migration of the current system to the 2.0 database rules, with the same rehearsals.

Finding: The idempotency table is pruned on use after a time limit; there is no scheduled clean-up report.
Why it is not P0 / what protects today: Rows older than the limit are removed when keys are checked.
Proposed work: Add a job and a count to the health page.
